children: Provident Financial Holdings Inc reported net income of $6.7M for fiscal 2026, up from $6.3M a year earlier, as net interest income rose and efficiency improved despite shifts in deposit mix and higher prepayments.
Revenue (Net interest income) was $36.3M for FY 2026, compared with $35.5M in FY 2025; YoY change 2%.
Net income was $6.7M for FY 2026, compared with $6.3M in FY 2025; YoY change 6%.
Diluted EPS was $1.03 for FY 2026, compared with $0.93 in FY 2025; YoY change 10.8%.
Net interest revenue momentum: Net interest income rose 2% to $36.3M, driven by a 16 basis-point improvement in net interest margin from lower funding costs and higher loan yields.
Deposit and funding shift: Deposit mix moved toward higher-cost time deposits (up 13%) with growth in brokered CDs, while transaction accounts declined.

Loan origination and channel activity: Loan originations increased 32% to $162.3M, concentrated in single-family, multi-family and commercial real estate; higher prepayments prompted competitive repricing.
Operational efficiency and cost control: Efficiency ratio improved to 77% as non-interest expense grew just 1% despite investments in technology and higher compensation.
